title: fix(cloud-connection): POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local parses the package id through its declaration
body:
Fixes #19576

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` now parses the package id it installs through its declaration, `ManifestSchema.shape.id` (by reference, never a copy of the grammar). An id `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` refuses is answered `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` with the declaration's own sentence (`manifestIdRefusal`, surfaced, not reworded). The status is `400` for an inline manifest and `502` for a cloud snapshot. Nothing is registered or written.

Diff measured between `b81da66df773` (merge base, `origin/main` at dispatch) and `37b8ecfd027c` (head). 4 files, +477 / -6.

## The change

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `handleInstall`:

- **Before:** `const manifestId = String(manifest?.id ?? manifest?.name ?? '')`. Nothing parsed it. `late-app`, `com.example.my_erp`, the number `123`, or a manifest carrying only a `name` installed with `200`, and the value became the ledger file's key and the `:manifestId` route key.
- **After:** one parse, at the one point where both branches have converged: the inline manifest (after `normalizeBundle` has flattened a compiled bundle) and the cloud-fetched snapshot. The parse sits ahead of the `409 MANIFEST_CONFLICT` collision check, the ADR-0120 D5e posture gate, the hot-register and the ledger write. **Validity is answered before collision.**
- **`manifest.name` is no longer read as an id.** `ManifestSchema` declares `id`, and `name` is an unpatterned display label. The inline branch's early refusal `Inline manifest must have an "id" or "name".` was deleted with the fallback it described. The inline `packageId` is now assigned from the parsed id, so no second, looser derivation remains.
- **The message:** a string id surfaces the parse's own issue message, which is `manifestIdRefusal('manifest.id', raw)` by construction. A non-string id (absent, a number) fails the leg's type check first. That check's generic zod sentence names neither the key nor the form, so for that case the door calls `manifestIdRefusal('manifest.id', raw)` directly. Every refusal therefore names `manifest.id` and states the rule.
- **Error code:** the existing ledgered `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` is reused, with the same `inlineManifest ? 400 : 502` split this door already uses for an invalid manifest. No new error code was added, and `packages/spec` is untouched.

## Doors that are deliberately NOT gated: what an already-installed non-conforming entry does

Rehydrate at `kernel:ready` and the three `:manifestId` routes (`DELETE`, `reseed-sample-data`, `purge-sample-data`) act on ledger entries that already exist, so they are not gated. After this change, an entry that an older build installed under a now-refused id (for example a ledger file `late-app.json`) behaves as follows:

- **it still rehydrates** at boot: pinned, `manifest.register` receives it and no error is logged;
- **it can still be removed** with `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/late-app`: pinned, answers `200`, and the ledger no longer has it;
- **it cannot be re-installed under that id**: pinned, a fresh POST answers `400`, and the existing entry is left byte-for-byte at its old version.

## Blast radius, measured BEFORE enforcing (the triage rider)

Readings on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `e5786a58` (the gate commit; the only later commit tightens the new test file's assertions) unless stated otherwise.

| probe | reading | control |
| --- | --- | --- |
| every id the new parse saw across the WHOLE `@objectstack/cloud-connection` suite (a setup-file spy on `ManifestSchema.shape.id.safeParse`, recording file, test and value) | **90 parses from 14 test files (70 of them from the 13 pre-existing files). 0 refused outside the new suite.** The 13 pre-existing files drive `app.test.crm`, `app.test.helpdesk`, `app.test.hotcrm`, `app.test.pipeline`, `app.test.proj`, `app.acme.crm`, `app.user.foo`, `app.mk.bar`, `app.brand.new`, `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, `com.acme.crm`, `com.acme.flat`, `com.acme.gated`, `com.acme.mrp`, `com.acme.clean` and `com.acme.tenancy`. All of them conform. | the same spy recorded all **15** refusals of the new suite, so the instrument sees a refusal when there is one |
| test fixtures that needed a new id | **none. No fixture was moved** (old id to new id: n/a) | the PM's lead named `late-app`. Its only hit is `packages/objectql/src/plugin.integration.test.ts:237`, which calls `manifest.register` directly and never reaches this door |
| other packages' tests driving this POST | none. The 4 cli test files that name `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` (`serve-marketplace-*.test.ts` ×3, `serve-capability-identity.test.ts`) mount or plan it, and a grep of them for `POST`, `fetch(` and `.post(` answers 0 lines | `git grep MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` outside `packages/cloud-connection/src` lists those 4 test files plus `install.ts`, `serve.ts`, `examples/app-showcase` and docs, all opened |
| `os package install` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts:130`) | the artifact path sends `id: artifact.manifest.id ?? artifact.id`. That id comes from a built artifact, and `defineStack` refuses both `late-app` and a manifest without `id` (probed: `manifest.id: Required property 'id' is missing`). The catalog path sends `packageId` only, and the parse reads the snapshot's `manifest.id` | a conforming `defineStack` manifest is accepted by the same probe |
| `examples/*` builds | `com.example.crm`, `.showcase`, `.todo`, `com.example.multi.core`, `com.example.multi.orders`: all conform | the platform checklist item `platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle` installs `examples/app-crm` through this door, and that id conforms |
| Studio import (objectui, read-only, pinned `.objectui-sha` `62597c58`, same code on main `a3380379`) | `PackagesPage.tsx:850` (at the pin) forwards the user's file unchanged. It mints no id, so it is **not a sender that depends on the fallback**. Its client pre-check does mirror the retired rule (`!manifest.id && !manifest.name`, i18n `missing "id" or "name"`). See Acceptance notes | the Studio catalog install (`marketplaceApi.ts:675`) sends `packageId` only |
| the cloud snapshot shape | **NOT MEASURED**: the snapshot writer lives in `objectstack-ai/cloud`, which this session cannot read (an attach request was denied). The in-repo contract side is `PackageSchema.manifestId` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:172`), which carries the same `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` on the publish face | — |

**The measured answer is that no first-party code sends this door a refused id.** The narrowing refuses hand-built caller input only. There is no grandfather clause and no route around it.

## PM mechanism assumptions: what was measured

1. **Convergence point `:763`: confirmed.** The gate went there. The card's probe was reproduced first as a failing test: `late-app` inline answered `200` (`expected 200 to be 400`).
2. **Name fallback: confirmed and removed.** No first-party sender depends on it (table above).
3. **Status by branch under the existing `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`: confirmed.** No new code was needed, so the claim's `Clause-②: no` basis holds on that axis.
4. **Only the install POST is gated: confirmed and pinned** (section above).
5. **"Some test ids are refused": falsified.** 0 of 70 pre-existing parses were refused, so no fixture moved.

## Both directions pinned

New file `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-id-gate.test.ts`, 22 cases. Every refusal row except the repair-arm row asserts the declared envelope (`BaseResponseSchema`, `envelopeViolations` empty, `ApiErrorSchema`), `code` and `status`, a message **identical to `manifestIdRefusal('manifest.id', value)`**, and that **nothing was written**: no `manifest.register` after boot, no `syncSchemas` after boot, and an unchanged ledger directory. The repair-arm row asserts the message only, because the message is its subject.

- **Refused inline, 400:** `late-app`, `com.example.my_erp`, `com.1acme.crm`, `Com.Acme.Crm`, a whitespace-padded `com.acme.crm` (the raw value is parsed), `''`, a name-only manifest, a manifest with neither key, and `id: 123`.
- **Refused compiled bundle, 400:** a nested `manifest.id` of `late-app` is refused after `normalizeBundle`.
- **Refused cloud snapshot, 502:** `late-app`, and a name-only snapshot. `fetch` was called exactly once, so the refusal came from the snapshot.
- **Validity before collision:** a refused id that local code also registered answers `400`, not `409`.
- **The repair survives:** `com.example.my_erp` still carries `'com.example.my-erp'`.
- **Lit controls:** `com.example.crm`, `com.example.my-erp` and `org.apache.superset` inline, plus a conforming compiled bundle and a conforming snapshot. Each installs with `200`, is registered once with the id intact, and gets a ledger file named for the id.
- **Legacy entry:** rehydrates, `DELETE` removes it, and re-install is refused (see above).

## Reverse verification: direction predicted BEFORE running, restore proven

| leg | predicted | measured |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **repro**: the first version of the new suite against the unmodified door (`b81da66d` plus the test file only, before commit) | every refusal row red, every lit control and legacy row green | **15 failed / 7 passed**. The card's probe: `late-app` inline answered `200` |
| **ablation**: at head `37b8ecfd`, the committed gate block replaced by the old `String(manifest?.id ?? manifest?.name ?? '')` derivation, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 to x0, blob `ce38ed611189` to `7560ea96170f`) | the same 15 red, the 7 controls green | **15 failed / 7 passed**. Restore: blob back to `ce38ed611189` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, and `git status --porcelain` empty. The same leg at `e5786a58` read the same 15 / 7 |

The subject resolves from `src/` (the suite imports `./marketplace-install-local-plugin.js` inside its own package), so `dist/` is not on the resolution path of this ablation.

## Docs

`content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`: the page taught `409 MANIFEST_CONFLICT` as the install refusal. A bullet beside it now states that the collision check is the second refusal, not the first: `400 PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` with the declaration's remedy (`502` from a catalog snapshot), nothing written, and a `name` is not an id. A search of `content/docs/**` (outside `references/` and `releases/`) for `install-local`, `package install`, `MANIFEST_CONFLICT`, `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` and `id or name` found no other statement this change makes false. `cli.mdx` lists `401`, the D5e stop and `404` for `os package install` without claiming completeness. The CLI prints the new refusal as `Install failed (400): ` followed by the declaration's sentence (`install.ts:208`).

## Changeset, and one point for the seat

`.changeset/19576-install-local-id-gate.md`: `@objectstack/cloud-connection` **`minor`**, a `**BREAKING for callers of the install-local door**` banner, and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition. It carries the PR's `Clause-②: no` line verbatim.

⚠️ **This departs from the order's suggested `patch`, on purpose, and the reason is stated here.** The two landed sibling gates for this same class, `f9977c11` (HTTP door) and `2306a75e` (protocol primitive), each declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, shipped `minor`, and carried the BREAKING banner plus the same ADR-0087 disposition. Per AGENTS.md, a `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, and a breaking change ships `minor` during the launch window. This door's accept set narrows the same way theirs did. The claim's line is bare `Clause-②: no` (no direction arm), and this body copies it verbatim, as the frame requires. **If the seat agrees this is a narrowing, the fix is a seat edit of this body's line to `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.** The `minor` level already satisfies the level axis under either spelling. The dev did not choose between the two silently.

## Gates, at head `37b8ecfd`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` re-derived **89** commands from the real diff, identical to the PM's list, at both commits. **`--ran` reconciliation at `37b8ecfd`: 89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, all exit 0.
- Three gates first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) and were converted by building what they read. None of them was read as a pass before that:
  - `check:skill-examples`: built `@objectstack/client-react` and its closure, then 259 examples type-checked.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: built the 4 packages still missing `dist/`, then 104 entry points across 67 packages loaded.
  - `check:type-check-debt`: `--re-measure` of 4 ledger entries in 103.8 s, 53 raw errors, none above its recorded number. Independently, `tsc --noEmit -p packages/cloud-connection/tsconfig.json` gives 13 errors, equal to its DEBT entry. `--listFiles` shows both changed `.ts` files in the program, with 0 errors in them.
- ⚠️ **One tree-state repair:** a first `check:type-check-debt` run was cut at a 400 s per-gate budget while it was building the closure. That left `plugin-auth` and `plugin-approvals` with JS but no `.d.ts` in this worktree only (`check:dts-closure` named the second one). Both were rebuilt, and `check:dts-closure` then read 153/153 declaration files across 64 packages. Nothing was committed from it.
- Roster gates whose roster sits under a changed directory were run by hand at `e5786a58`, all exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:route-ledger-census`, `check:tenant-chokepoint`. Also exit 0: `check:adr-anchors` and `check:durability-log-level`.
- **`pnpm lint` (the full union, `eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0, no output, 108 s, at `37b8ecfd`.**
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` tests: **30 files / 396 tests pass** at `37b8ecfd`.
- The `Check Changeset` level axis was not run locally, because it needs this PR's event payload. With the bare `no` line it stands down, and `minor` is admissible under either spelling.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **Studio import pre-check mirrors the retired rule.** objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx:850` (at pin `62597c58`) pre-checks `!manifest.id && !manifest.name`, and its i18n string reads `missing "id" or "name"`. After this change, a name-only file passes that client check and gets the server's `400` carrying the declaration's remedy, which the page shows through its envelope reader (`apiJson` then `readEnvelopeFailureText`, `PackagesPage.tsx:123`). The refusal is loud, not silent, so no card was filed. The pre-check is simply looser than the server now. Carrier: whoever next edits that objectui page (承接者:无).
- `manifestIdOf` (`:133`) still reads `manifest.name` as a last resort. It classifies packages already in the engine registry for `findConflict`, not install input, and was left alone.
